newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread denies interest in Man Utd.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread denies interest in Man Utd.

text.p: Whitbread Plc on Friday denied having expresssed any interest in buying Manchester United Plc, after a report in the Times newspaper said Whitbread and Granada Group Plc had expressed an interest in the soccer club.
"It is not true that we have expressed an interest," said a spokeswoman for Whitbread.

"We would love to buy the club but there are as many beer drinkers in Liverpool, Newcastle and Chelsea," she said, adding that Whitbread would not want to do anything to upset customers who were fans of other clubs.
"The report is complete rubbish," the spokeswoman said.
The Times report sent Manchester United sharply higher in early trading on Friday, rising as much as 47-1/2p to a record 500p, though they later came back to be up 27p at 479-1/2 by 0751 GMT.
No-one at Manchester United or Granada was immediately available for comment. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
